# Synthetic academics — test fixture only

## Subjects Offered

For Classes 1-5 (Primary): English, Mathematics and Art.

For Classes 6-8 (Middle): English, Mathematics and Science.

For Class 9 and Class 10 (Secondary): English, Mathematics, Science and Social Science.

For Classes 11-12 (Senior Secondary), streams include:

- PCM: Physics, Chemistry, Mathematics and Computer Science
- Commerce: Accountancy, Business Studies and Economics

## Homework Policy

Homework is assigned daily. Students should complete homework on time.

## Examination Pattern

The school follows a synthetic examination pattern:
- Unit Test: July
- Final Examination: March
